Durability of the INDUSTRY-LEVEL fare recapture + ULCC supply exit if fuel moderates - the 2026Q2 print moved the hinge off "does premium decouple from main cabin" (it partly answered that the other way: main-cabin unit revenue EXCEEDED premium in Q2 on a 30% ULCC capacity withdrawal, not on premium decoupling). The thesis now hinges on management's untested assertion that "current revenue momentum should remain sustainable even if fuel prices moderate" (2026Q2), because the reaffirmed FY2026 guide requires H2 EPS of $4.30-$5.30 (+32% to +63% YoY) after an H1 that fell 14% YoY.
